title: VoT: Vision-of-Thought for Unified Multimodal Representation Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2609.07815v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current text-to-image systems typically employ a "text encoder plus diffusion decoder" paradigm, in which text semantics directly modulate continuous latent noise. Despite their success, these methods lack an explicit, interpretable intermediate representation that effectively bridges high-level linguistic semantics and low-level visual signals. In this paper, we propose Vision-of-Thought (VoT), a framework that introduces a discrete visual-thinking layer between vision-language models (VLMs) and diffusion transformers (DiTs). Instead of treating VLMs merely as text encoders, we use them as multimodal planners that generate discrete VoT tokens representing high-level visual plans, such as objects and layouts, before rendering pixels. We train a specialized VoT tokenizer in the VLM semantic space with a closed-loop objective that combines VLM alignment, feature reconstruction, and vector-quantization losses. translated_title: VoT：思维视觉用于统一多模态表示对齐
translated_abstract: 当前的文本到图像系统通常采用“文本编码器加扩散解码器”的范式，其中文本语义直接调制连续的潜在噪声。尽管这些方法取得了成功，但它们缺乏一种显式的、可解释的中间表示来有效桥接高层语言语义与低层视觉信号。在本文中，我们提出了思维视觉，这是一个在视觉语言模型与扩散变换器之间引入离散视觉思维层的框架。我们不再将VLM仅仅当作文本编码器，而是将其用作多模态规划器，在渲染像素之前生成表示高层视觉规划（如物体和布局）的离散VoT token。我们在VLM语义空间中训练了一个专用的VoT分词器，其闭环目标函数结合了VLM对齐、特征重建和向量量化损失。这些目标使……
tldr: 提出思维视觉框架，在视觉语言模型与扩散变换器之间引入离散视觉思维层，让VLM作为多模态规划器生成表示物体和布局等高层视觉规划的离散token，从而在像素渲染前实现高层语义与低层视觉信号的显式、可解释对齐。
en_tdlr: Proposes Vision-of-Thought (VoT), a framework that introduces a discrete visual-thinking layer between VLMs and diffusion transformers, using the VLM as a multimodal planner to generate discrete tokens representing high-level visual plans such as objects and layouts, enabling explicit and interpretable alignment between high-level semantics and low-level visual signals before pixel rendering.
